score_reason: Affects many household subscribers, but based on an email seen by one outlet and changes take effect over coming months.
headline: Microsoft will let everyone on a Microsoft 365 Family or Premium plan share its Copilot AI features, with storage becoming one shared pool.
importance_line: Families can share one AI allowance, though plans with three or more users get less total storage, and The Verge says some may pay more for AI.
summary: The Verge reports that an email to subscribers shows Microsoft will let Microsoft 365 Family and Premium plan holders share a single Copilot AI allowance with up to five other people. From the first renewal after 2 May 2027, 1 TB of storage per person becomes 2 TB shared across the plan, and The Verge notes some subscribers could pay more for AI use.
notes: Source is The Verge (original not opened); text read at GNN, a copy site. Storage change applies after the first renewal after 2 May 2027.
